comment: The order in which ROR's institutions outside the US fill institutions-global.json's 900 KiB budget (docs/design/core.md §5.1, §5.3 step 5). After the records the curated tables name, the build takes two passes over this list: first the records with a Wikipedia link of every country in this order, then the records without one, each country's records by ROR id, and it stops at the first record that does not fit. So the linked records of the early countries come before the unlinked records of any (the linked pass ends in Iran, and Canada, the UK and Australia keep their linked records only). Countries not listed are never included. The order decides coverage only: which names are ambiguous is decided over every ROR candidate before the subset is taken. The order puts English-speaking job markets and the countries most US applicants studied in first; the owner chooses between this order, a per-country order (all of a country's records before the next) and per-country quotas.
